held_out_unlock: all six checkpoints frozen; all 24 dev owners completed without infrastructure failure; each original training seed has at least 2 goals among its 4 fixed dev scenes
held_out_use: collect four held-out teacher runs only after unlock; evaluate all six models once on those records and all eight fresh closed-loop scenes; no refitting, model selection or replacement
hidden_state: zero at episode start; carry and detach at each 32-tick training-window boundary
interface: unchanged artificial 388-feature encoder and upstream cell/readout; fixed recurrent positive-count weights; no privileged student inputs
order: increasing declared scene seed, episode 0, increasing tick; identical across all six models
report_policy: report all six models, paired per-scene outcomes, every seed and failure; scenes/model seeds are experimental units, not ticks
rewiring: existing degree-preserving swaps, count and weight multiset; declared seed only, no reachability screening/retries
scope: bounded research preparation and candidate development; no topology advantage, biology, generalization or R3 completion claim
selection: minimum recorded-dev loss over exactly 20 epochs; first epoch wins exact ties; no winning seed or held-out selection
stop_policy: first infrastructure/data/source/finite/budget error stops stage; retain all planned rows and not_started rows; failed dev gate leaves both held-out stages unopened
training_graph: unchanged pinned 138-node 1647-edge extraction; W[post,pre]; original incoming-strength scalar shared with matched control
